title: Jason Licht "very optimistic" about Baker Mayfield staying beyond 2026

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jason Licht "very optimistic" about Baker Mayfield staying beyond 2026
sources.description: Baker Mayfield said he felt disrespected and undervalued by the contract offers that came from the Buccaneers this offseason, so the quarterback is now set to play out the final year of his current deal.
